Read pie charts · Draw pie charts · Grouped data

by Hasan

Wednesday

🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can read a pie chart using fractions of 360°

✓ I can work out angles and draw a pie chart

✓ I can put data into groups with a tally and frequency table

So you can read the charts in reports and sort data at work!

[2 marks]

Answer

90° is a quarter of 360°.

Answer:

1

4

, 50 shoppers
